testcase.name: keys are sorted by code point, arrays keep their order, nested values are canonical
Unicode is preserved as-is: no NFC/NFD normalization, no case folding, no trimming
large integers travel as decimal strings and keep their exact digits; unsafe JSON numbers are rejected
the profile rejects non-finite numbers, undefined, duplicate keys and lone surrogates
code-point ordering differs from UTF-16 unit ordering for astral characters
array order is meaning: reordering changes the digest; the same content in another key order does not
digests are domain-separated and versioned; the preimage is the closed wrapper
interoperability anchor: a structured digest equals the raw digest of its exact preimage bytes
registry provenance verifies and every vendored file is hashed
generated catalogue matches the vendored registry
every command has a unique id, an HTTP method/path and a declared idempotency and gate
state machines reference contracts and their enum states; initial and terminal states exist
